Toast the bread if you like and spread with the avocado cream. Slice the tomatoes and lay them on top with the sliced eggs.

Put the eggs into boiling water and hard-boil for 8–10 min. Cool in cold water and peel. Eat with a little salt.

Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper. Let them set in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 2–3 min, stirring. Dice the tomatoes and add them or eat them on the side. Serve with the wholemeal bread.

Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper. Dice the pepper and fry in a non-stick pan for 3 min. Pour the egg mixture over it, let it set over low heat and fold. Serve with cottage cheese and wholemeal bread.
